speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Transport whether the Ministry will consider increasing the quantum of rebates provided under the Electric Vehicle Early Adoption Incentive scheme and extending the scheme to the end of 2026.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Senior Minister of State Amy Khor, I hope it is a short answer.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister of Transport)
text: Today, it is really a short answer; just two paragraphs, Mr Speaker, Sir.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the day.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
